subject: Bridge extension & combined credits + rate carveout for StrideCore POC
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily@stridecore.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short extension + credits to finish POC

Hi Soojin,

Hope you had a nice weekend. Quick update from our side: the POC ran into an unexpected data ingestion delay last week when one of our telemetry feeds started dropping events. That pushed our evaluation window out by ~10 days. We should be able to complete the quality checks, but we don't have enough hosted credits left in the trial to finish the last set of prompts.

Ask: could Redwood extend the trial by 3 weeks and provide an additional pool of credits (we were thinking $45k) so the engineering and ML teams can finish full-scale validation? If we can demonstrate the expected latency and cost targets, we are ready to talk commit and expansion.

I attached the latest telemetry sample and a short usage slide showing where we are blocked.

Thanks,
Emily Zhao
Head of ML Engineering, StrideCore
Attachments: StrideCore_POCTelemetry.csv, Usage_Slides.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@stridecore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + credits to finish POC

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. I reviewed the telemetry; the drop pattern is consistent with the buffer config we saw in the staging env, so this looks transient.

Internally, I'm recommending the following exception to keep momentum:
- 21 day extension on the trial window
- $40,000 in redemption credits applied to StrideCore's trial account
- an introductory rate carveout: 12% off our standard list rates for the first 12 months, contingent on a 6-month minimum committed spend to be formalized in the SOW

This is slightly below the $45k you asked for but balances commercial risk with a reasonable sweetener to accelerate conversion. I can approve this only with senior-commercial sign-off (Marcus) because it affects committed pricing. Can I ask Marissa and Marcus for quick review/exec approval?

If we get approval, we'll issue a conditional SOW and a DocuSign envelope for signatures.

Thanks,
Soojin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + credits to finish POC

Soojin — thanks for the recommendation. A couple of quick questions before I greenlight:
- Do we have clear signal on ARR potential if StrideCore converts at the proposed rate? (ballpark 12–18 mo ARR projection)
- Can we gate the credits so they only apply to inference tokens (not embeddings) to avoid misuse?

If those checks are positive, I'm comfortable with the $40k credit + 12% for 6 months as a conditional offer. Marcus — want to weigh in on the pricing carveout?

-Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + credits to finish POC

Quick answers:
- ARR signal: internal forecast (attached in the HubSpot deal) shows a 12mo ARR midpoint of $315k if they convert to a committed tier after a successful POC. I included a link to the deal in the metadata.
- Gating: engineering can apply a token-label rule to restrict the credit pool to generation endpoints only; we'll push a small RBAC flag and tag the billing lines so finance can audit usage.

If everyone is comfortable I suggest Marcus provide exec sign-off with a single-line approval and we draft the conditional SOW for signature. I'm happy to relay terms to Emily and kick off DocuSign.

Thanks — Soojin
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 13:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + credits to finish POC

Approvable with conditions. Approved: $40,000 in trial credits + 12% introductory rate carveout for first 12 months. Conditions:
1) Credits gated to generation endpoints only (no embeddings or third-party connectors).
2) Signed conditional SOW with 6-month minimum committed spend to be returned within 7 business days of envelope delivery.
3) Finance to review credit accounting — Ben, please validate treatment and add a memo to the deal.

Soojin, you have exec sign-off to communicate the terms to StrideCore and to start the DocuSign flow. Marissa — I'll leave final contracting language to you and legal.

—Marcus
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily@stridecore.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@stridecore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + credits to finish POC

Hi Emily / Oliver — great news: we can support the extension and credits you requested with one modification to the terms. Approved offer (conditional):
- 21 day extension to your trial window
- $40,000 in Redwood trial credits applied to generation endpoints only
- 12% introductory rate carveout for the first 12 months, subject to a signed conditional SOW with a 6-month minimum committed spend

Next steps:
1) I will send a conditional SOW via DocuSign (link will come from Redwood Legal). Please review and sign within 7 business days to lock in the rate and credits.
2) Ben (cc) will coordinate a short finance memo describing the credit accounting; Marissa will follow up with the contract language.
3) Once signed, we'll activate the gated credit pool and extend the trial.

Link to conditional SOW (preview): https://app.docusign.com/ENVELOPE/0000-STRD-SOW
Attachments: StrideCore_SOW_v1.docx

Looking forward to the final validation. If you want a quick sync to walk through the gating and billing, I'm available Wednesday afternoon.

Best,
Soojin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
